notes.title: Final Roadmap Update Is Live!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Wanderers! 😺[/b][/h2][p]
It took us a bit more time than expected, just over a month to be exact😅, but here it is - the latest update for [i]Songs of Rats[/i] and our final free update to the game! And it's a [b]FAT[/b] one 🐀, as it brings not two (as announced initially), but [b]THREE[/b] [b]new campaigns[/b]! We hope this will sweeten the delay a little bit.[/p][p][/p][p]We've been listening to your feedback carefully, and with these campaigns, we aimed to give you [b]more choices[/b] and [b]more freedom[/b] in how you shape your path and story in [b]The Wreckage[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]🔽 [b]Scroll down[/b] for all the important info and details on the new content.🔽[/p][p]   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/15d2195d825c001bdf74dcb2292cbe25a5ca85ba.png"][/img][/p][p]
🧑‍💻 So here are all the tasty details! 👍  [/p][p][/p][h2]CAMPAIGN #3 - The Way Is The Most Important[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/678a9295152df60acc4583f9ed474a9f692f2ab7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In this new campaign, there's no set path and no clear goal - just you, a map of interconnected locations, and the freedom to go wherever you want. Each spot leads to 2–3 others, letting you carve your own route through the world.[/p][p]Along the way, you’ll be able to interact with the environment, meet other travelers, and hear rumors,  some of which may point you toward something bigger. But don’t expect the game to spell it out.[/p][p]Behind the scenes, your choices are quietly tracked. Depending on what you’ve done, certain locations may trigger [b]hidden endings[/b] instead of the usual scenes. For example:[/p][list][*][p]Visit 10 different locations before reaching the Keykeeper’s Den? You might find something waiting.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete three cult initiations? A spiritual path could open.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn the respect of key factions? The Council might call on you.[/p][/*][/list][p]You won’t see progress bars or quest markers — just consequences. What you find at the end depends entirely on how you’ve played.[/p][p][/p][h2]CAMPAIGN #4 - After The Silence[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/637ec8195add198d5d57c36e69bdfcb6b7c9ee03.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This campaign introduces a new core mechanic: the [b]Clan Panel[/b]. As you explore and scavenge, you’ll collect scrap - and instead of hoarding it, you’ll invest it directly into your clan’s growth.[/p][p]You can upgrade three key traits: [b]Body[/b], [b]Mind[/b], and [b]Spirit[/b]. Each point you unlock makes the next one more expensive, so you’ll need to choose your path carefully. Once you’ve maxed out every trait available, the final scene triggers - but what happens next depends entirely on how you developed your clan.[/p][p]There are [b]four possible endings[/b], based on your strongest stat:[/p][list][*][p]Body-dominant[/p][/*][*][p]Spirit-dominant[/p][/*][*][p]Mind-dominant[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced[/p][/*][/list][p]There’s no right or wrong answer - just the story of the clan [i]you[/i] chose to build.[/p][p][/p][h2]CAMPAIGN #5 - Trial Time[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/84b0aecd964676016efdda77e61c36e79328d0cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You’ve waited your whole life for this moment - just like everyone else in your group. Now, finally, your trial has come.[/p][p]The Council has spoken: before you can become a caravanner, before you’re trusted with trade routes and responsibility, you must bring back something of value, something ancient, something real. [/p][p]If you succeed, there's a chance you'll be allowed to travel The Wreckage [b]not alone[/b], but alongside the people who matter most, your friends: [b]Aron, Freya, and Hogor[/b]. You've trained with them, fought beside them, and dreamed of this moment together.[/p][p]In this campaign your choices will determine whether you earn your place - and whether you and your friends live to see the road ahead. [/p][p][/p][h2]LAST BUT NOT LEAST[/h2][p][/p][p]Of course that's not all! We’ve also fixed a few pesky bugs 🐛 here and there and added some [b]new achievements[/b] you can unlock by completing the latest campaigns🏆. We really hope you’ll enjoy all the new content - it brings [b]many more hours of gameplay[/b], and we can't wait to hear your thoughts on these new experiences![/p][p]Thank you so much for sticking with us, for all your feedback, comments, and reviews! 🙏 We truly appreciate it![/p][p]And who knows... maybe this won’t be our [b]last word[/b] when it comes to The Wreckage? 😉[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/7e5c81d93e87ca7972a1475c73e5262521c444a0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Traditionally, we would also like to encourage you to check out the EBOOK, which contains a short novel (Uriel's Song) offering deeper insight into the lore of [i]Songs of Rats[/i] and The Wreckage.[/b] If you'd like to explore more of the world, we think it could be a good read!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545330/Songs_of_Rats__Tales_from_the_Shadows_EBOOK/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][h3]Your support means everything!😺 [/h3][p]
Once again, we can’t thank you enough for being part of [i]Songs of Rats[/i] and exploring The Wreckage. If you don’t own the game yet, we highly encourage you to [b]try the demo[/b] - we’d love for you to join us on this adventure!

And finally, if you’re enjoying the game, [b]please consider leaving a positive review on Steam[/b]. As a small indie team, your reviews help us tremendously in reaching more players and growing our community. Every single one counts and is deeply appreciated! 🙏

🤛 Thank you all once again for your amazing support. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see you exploring The Wreckage. Enjoy the adventure!

notes.title: New version available + what to expect in the future!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Wanderers!😺[/b][/h2]

[h3]We are 9 days after the release, and it has been a busy time for us. But as Britney sang in her song, we were born to make you happy, so we wanted to implement some of your requests! :D[/h3]

First, a huge thank you to all those who checked out our game, and a big hug to everyone who left us a positive review - this really helps a lot! It's tough for a small dev like us to get exposure on Steam, and positive ratings truly make a difference. We sincerely appreciate your support!👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/7e5c81d93e87ca7972a1475c73e5262521c444a0.gif[/img]

🐀 We would also like to involve you in the process of making [i]Songs of Rats[/i] even better. As you probably already know, we read all comments and reviews, gathering your feedback and requests. Step by step, we aim to implement the requested changes and improvements, and the first batch is ready! Check out the log below for details.⬇️⬇️⬇️

[b]Last but not least, we’d love for you to write in the comments about the kind of new content you'd like to see in [i]Songs of Rats[/i][/b]. Additional events? A new campaign? Both? Any other ideas? We're open to suggestions and will happily implement whatever we can. So don’t hesitate to share your requests with us! :)

[h3]🛠️[b] Below, you’ll find what’s new/updated in version 1.1.5, which is now live! [/b][/h3]

[list] 
[*] [Community request] Removed Master Volume in Settings. Instead, there are now two sliders: one for music volume and one for sound effects.✅
[*] [Community request] You can now choose whether to heal yourself using food or first aid kits (if available). Just click on the food or first aid kit icon below the healing button to select which resource you prefer to use.✅
[*] The Artbook (The Art of the Wreckage) has been expanded with almost 20 extra pages, offering more insight into the game's creation, including a step-by-step breakdown of the graphics development process.✅
[*] Fixed typos and text errors.✅
[*] Fixed event display issues.✅
[*] Fixed additional English translation errors in the EBOOK.✅
[*] Various small bug fixes.✅
[/list]
[h3]And what about the future? 🚀[/h3]

We haven’t prepared a roadmap per se, but as stated above, we want to bring more content to the game. We're a small team, so every change takes a bit of time, especially since each new version needs proper testing. That’s why we don’t want to set fixed dates in stone.

However, in the upcoming weeks and months, you can expect additional content. We want it to align with your expectations, so once again: [b]please share your ideas and requests in the comments![/b] This will help us determine the right development path for the game. :)

[b]We also encourage you to check out the EBOOK, which contains a short novel (Uriel's Song) offering deeper insight into the lore of [i]Songs of Rats[/i] and The Wreckage.[/b] If you'd like to explore more of the world, we think it could be a good read!

Once again, we can’t thank you enough for being part of [i]Songs of Rats[/i] and exploring The Wreckage. If you don’t own the game yet, we highly encourage you to [b]try the demo[/b] - we’d love for you to join us on this adventure!

notes.title: Post-Launch Update: Fixes, Tweaks, and What's Next
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Wanderers!😺[/b][/h2]

[h3]It's been 24 hours since launch – a huge THANK YOU to all of you! 🎉[/h3]

It’s been a full day since the launch of [i]Songs of Rats[/i], and we are absolutely thrilled by how active and engaged the community is! Seeing so many of you exploring The Wreckage, sharing feedback, and diving into the world we created means a lot! Thank you for being part of this journey!👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/7e5c81d93e87ca7972a1475c73e5262521c444a0.gif[/img]

[h3]🛠️All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy 🤪 - but jokes aside, it's been a busy day! [/h3]

We’ve been hard at work addressing all reported feedback and bugs (pesky little things!) as quickly as possible. Because of this, we pushed out multiple updates throughout the day, tackling (hopefully) all major and critical issues. We now believe that the current version is perfectly stable and shouldn’t have any game-breaking blockers! 🧐

[h3][b]That being said, here’s what we’ve fixed and improved:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the way weapons and armor take damage + balance tweaks.
[*] Rebalanced critical hit and miss chances in combat.
[*] Improved the localization system.
[*] Fixed typos and text errors.
[*] Enhanced text sound effects.
[*] Fixed event display issues.
[*] Resolved bugs that blocked gameplay after events.
[*] Fixed the ending for Sandbox mode (100-day run).
[*] Achievements fixes.
[*] Improved Steam Deck support.
[*] Minor text adjustments.
[*] Fixed English translation errors in the EBOOK.
[*] Removed duplicate text from one of the short stories in the EBOOK.
[*] Minor tweaks to the Artbook.
[*] Various small bug fixes.
[/list]
[h3]What’s Next? 🚀[/h3]

If nothing major pops up in the next few days, we’ll begin implementing community-requested features! Some of the top suggestions we’re considering include:

✅ The ability to switch between healing with first aid kits or food.
✅ Additional sound settings.
✅ And more tweaks based on your feedback!

[h3]Your support means everything!😺 [/h3]

We can’t thank you enough for being part of [i]Songs of Rats[/i] and exploring The Wreckage. If you don’t own the game yet, we highly encourage you to [b]give the demo a try[/b], we’d love for you to join us on this adventure! 

Lastly, if you’re enjoying the game, [b]please consider leaving a positive review on Steam[/b]. We’re a small indie team, and your reviews help us tremendously in reaching more players and growing our community. Every single one counts and is deeply appreciated! 🙏

🤛 Thank you all once again for your amazing support. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see you exploring The Wreckage. Enjoy the adventure!

notes.title: Songs of Rats - DEMO VERSION AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello brave Wanderers![/b][/h2]

[h3]We've got some great news to share today! But first of all, thank you so much to everyone who participated in our playtest. Your feedback was incredibly valuable, we have closely and attentively watched all the videos and read all the comments and blogs. This has allowed us to introduce various improvements in game events, balancing, and other areas. So once again, thank you so much for participating and giving us the chance to make [i]Songs of Rats[/i] a much better experience![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266853/7e5c81d93e87ca7972a1475c73e5262521c444a0.gif[/img]

Now, let's move on to the most important point. A playable Demo Version, accessible to all, is now live! It features many changes based on the feedback we've gathered. We believe the difference is significant, so if you participated in the playtests, you might want to check it out and see the progress. And if you didn’t, now is a great time to experience [i]Songs of Rats[/i]!

What’s also important is that the Demo Version supports Windows and Linux (including SteamOS, so Steam Deck*) as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309930/Songs_of_Rats_Demo/

[h3]Here are the details of the Demo Version:[/h3]

[list]
[*] This version includes all the gameplay mechanics and modes that will appear in the full game, but the story length and sandbox mode are limited.
[*] A save system is not yet available.
[*] The full version will also include additional languages and full gamepad support.
[*] The full version will feature an extra scenario!
[/list]

* - For Steam Deck make sure to turn on the Steam Linux Runtime 1.0 on your device.

[h3]Also, a few gameplay tips:[/h3]

[list]
[*] At the beginning, try to avoid fights - you might prefer to focus on buffing your character with better gear.
[*] During confrontations, you can heal your character by using First Aid packs or eating food.
[*] If the enemy is clearly stronger than you, try to run away!
[/list]

Of course, keep your feedback coming! There’s still some time left until the release in March, so if you come across any bugs or have any thoughts on how to improve the experience, let us know - we will be more than happy to make improvements.

As a small but passionate indie team, your support means everything to us. We’d like to emphasize once more how much it would mean if you could consider adding [i]Songs of Rats[/i] to your wishlist. It’s a small gesture that makes a big difference. Thank you! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3300470/Songs_of_Rats/

Also, a big thanks for joining us on this journey. Until next time, when we’ll bring you a proper devlog with more about the universe of [i]Songs of Rats[/i]!
